name: DHC6
mesh_airframe: de Havilland Canada DHC-6 Twin Otter (FGMEMBERS dhc6 model)
hinge_note: hinge lines estimated from each surface's own leading-edge geometry (assets_pipeline/estimate_hinges.py); verified on screen by gate5_realmesh, not assumed

category.source: FAA TCDS A9EA (DHC-6 Twin Otter): certification basis CAR 3 normal category, whose 3.186 states the same load factors as 14 CFR 23.337 as it read before Amendment 23-64 (2017): (a)(1) positive limit manoeuvring load factor n = 2.1 + 24000/(W+10000), not less than 3.8 for the normal category; (b)(1) negative limit not less than 0.4 x positive = -1.52 -- unverified here: from memory of the TCDS

n_z_pos_g.source: 14 CFR 23.337 as it read before Amendment 23-64 (2017): (a)(1) positive limit manoeuvring load factor n = 2.1 + 24000/(W+10000), not less than 3.8 for the normal category; (b)(1) negative limit not less than 0.4 x positive = -1.52 -- normal category +3.8 g

n_z_neg_g.source: 14 CFR 23.337 as it read before Amendment 23-64 (2017): (a)(1) positive limit manoeuvring load factor n = 2.1 + 24000/(W+10000), not less than 3.8 for the normal category; (b)(1) negative limit not less than 0.4 x positive = -1.52 -- normal category -0.4 x 3.8 = -1.52 g

speed_limit_kt.source: unverified here: from memory of the DHC-6-300 Airplane Flight Manual limitations (V_NE 170 KIAS); compared here against JSBSim calibrated airspeed without a position-error correction

m_mo.reason: a turboprop of this class has no Mach operating limit; none is published for the DHC-6

alpha_stall_deg.reason: the JSBSim DHC6 model states no alpha limit (no <alphalimits> element; grep of DHC6.xml, 2026-09-28)

limits.note: Not flown here: the prompt compiler does not map 'DHC6' to this FDM name (measured 2026-09-28: 'fly the DHC6' compiles to aircraft 'dhc6', refused aircraft.exists); a spec that sets aircraft 'DHC6' by hand loads the model.

loading.source: JSBSim 1.2.4 aircraft/DHC6/DHC6.xml <mass_balance> and <propulsion> as shipped in the .venv wheel (read 2026-09-28); the maximum weight from memory of the DHC-6-300 type data [unverified here]

datum.xml: the DHC6.xml <location> x in inches, positive aft (the JSBSim structural frame); the XML names no reference point

arm_comparison.reason: no handbook arm is transcribed for the DHC-6: the envelope check is refused by name (loading.datum_unverified) and the loading is flown at the XML's own arms

empty_weight.source: DHC6.xml <emptywt> 8100 LBS at <location name="CG"> x 211.8 in

stations.name: name
stations.source: DHC6.xml <pointmass name="name"> 230 LBS at x 93.6 in (the XML's own station name, the crew position at the EYEPOINT arm); a stated choice, not a handbook limit: 150 kg per seat; the handbook bounds the seats through the maximum weight and the envelope, not per seat

tanks.source: DHC6.xml tank 0: <capacity> 1290.5 LBS, <contents> 892.1 LBS at x 211.8 in (at the empty CG)
DHC6.xml tank 1: <capacity> 1290.5 LBS, <contents> 892.1 LBS at x 211.8 in (at the empty CG)

max_takeoff_weight.source: from memory of the DHC-6-300 maximum takeoff weight 12500 lb [unverified here]

cg_envelope.reason: no handbook envelope transcribed for the DHC-6

loading.policy_station_reason: the model's one station (the XML names it "name"): a payload draw replaces its 230 lb

icing.source: Bragg, Hutchison, Merret, Oltman, Pokhariyal, AIAA 2000-0360, the Twin Otter k'_CA set of the Smart Icing Systems research (NASA Glenn Twin Otter, Ratvasky et al.), transcribed from memory [unverified here: the paper is not reachable from this container]; the DHC6 IS the Twin Otter (blueprint correction 7), so the row applies directly
icing.model: Bragg et al. 2000 factor form C_A,iced = (1 + eta k_A) C_A, applied per axis to the WHOLE axis by the icing injection (a stated simplification: Bragg's k applies to one coefficient of the axis)

k_lift.source: k'_CLalpha of the Twin Otter set as remembered (the lift-curve slope loss) [unverified here]; applied to the whole LIFT axis

k_drag.source: k'_CD0 of the Twin Otter set as remembered (the parasite drag rise) [unverified here]; applied to the whole DRAG axis

k_pitch.source: k'_Cmalpha of the Twin Otter set as remembered (the tail's pitch stiffness loss) [unverified here]; applied to the whole PITCH axis

k_roll.source: k'_Clp of the Twin Otter set as remembered (roll damping loss) [unverified here]; applied to the whole ROLL axis

k_yaw.source: k'_Cnbeta of the Twin Otter set as remembered (directional stiffness loss) [unverified here]; applied to the whole YAW axis

k_side.source: k'_CYbeta of the Twin Otter set as remembered [unverified here]; applied to the whole SIDE axis
